mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 66 degrees with overcast skies near the Verona Public Library, and we are currently under a waxing crescent moon.

The Verona Senior Center is seeking volunteers for various roles. Volunteers are asked to commit to at least two shifts per month and must maintain confidentiality regarding all participant information. Interested residents can fill out an online form, visit the front desk for an application, or call the center to get started.

We have a packed schedule starting today with the Dane County Farmer's Market and live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Cave Carnival at Cave of the Mounds or take the kids to the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena.
In a report from August 8th, a police drone pilot assisted the Dane County Sheriff's Office in locating a suspect vehicle that fled into a corn field during a burglary, leading to an arrest.
Today's flavor of the day is the classic Turtle, which is a fan favorite. Culver's is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM.
